name: gemini-cli
description: Google's Gemini CLI in one-shot mode (-p). Non-interactive: tool calls not covered by --allowed-tools have no TTY to confirm against, so they're effectively denied rather than prompted -- that's what curated relies on for its read-only restriction.
verificationNote: Base invocation and output schema confirmed against a live install (gemini-cli 0.10.0) with a real API call: `gemini -o json -m gemini-3.1-pro-preview -p "Reply with exactly: hello"` returned {"response": "hello", "stats": {...}}. The default model in older installs (gemini-2.5-pro) returns a 404 for new API keys as of 2026 -- gemini-3.1-pro-preview is required instead; re-check this if the CLI or API changes again. NOT independently re-verified: the exact tool names in policyArgs.curated (read_file/read_many_files/list_directory/glob/search_file_content) match this CLI's documented built-in tools but a live curated-policy run restricting them was not separately isolated from a claimcheck task run -- see the task run's raw output for whether the restriction actually held. No cost field: gemini-cli's JSON output reports token counts (stats.models.<model>.tokens), not a USD figure, so output.costField is intentionally omitted -- cost will show as "n/a" in reports for this agent, not comparable to total_cost_usd from other agents without a manual token-price conversion. No session-id field either.
